title: Community Outreach
source: Editorial A-list selection from original strip #237
summary: Community Outreach — Smugesh describes a free festival for the people living in occupied villages; the Dark Lord listens composedly.

panelPlan.action: Smugesh describes a free festival for the people living in occupied villages; the Dark Lord listens composedly.
Smugesh is surprised that his ruthless superior likes a seemingly cheerful community event.
The Dark Lord reveals that he intends to remove a hard-won source of happiness deliberately.

dialogueInline.speaker: Smugesh
dialogueInline.text: We've organized a festival for the occupied villages. Music, dancing, free food.

dialogueInline.speaker: Dark Lord
dialogueInline.text: Splendid.

dialogueInline.speaker: Smugesh
dialogueInline.text: I didn't realize you supported community events.

dialogueInline.speaker: Dark Lord
dialogueInline.text: People become accustomed to happiness remarkably quickly. We'll cancel it next year.

title: A Different Kind of Victory

summary: A Different Kind of Victory — Lady Raindew arrives to liberate an occupied village and is greeted by the mayor.

panelPlan.action: Lady Raindew arrives to liberate an occupied village and is greeted by the mayor.
The mayor points at a stout new occupation fortress built in the center of town.
The mayor reveals that successive invasions were the only way to obtain the new infrastructure.

dialogueInline.speaker: Lady Raindew
dialogueInline.text: We can free you by morning.

dialogueInline.speaker: Villager
dialogueInline.text: We appreciate that.

dialogueInline.speaker: Villager
dialogueInline.text: But please don't destroy the fortress.

dialogueInline.speaker: Lady Raindew
dialogueInline.text: Why not?

dialogueInline.speaker: Villager
dialogueInline.text: It took us three invasions to get them to build it.

summary: The Fourth-Quarter Rally — Smugesh bursts into a regional management meeting celebrating the company's rare military victory.

panelPlan.action: Smugesh bursts into a regional management meeting celebrating the company's rare military victory.
Smugesh admits the enemy army was away on a national holiday.
The Dark Lord calmly makes a strategic order based on the accidental opportunity.

dialogueInline.speaker: Smugesh
dialogueInline.text: We've won a battle! A decisive victory!

dialogueInline.speaker: Dark Lord
dialogueInline.text: Excellent! What changed?

dialogueInline.speaker: Smugesh
dialogueInline.text: Apparently, the enemy army was away celebrating a national holiday.

dialogueInline.speaker: Dark Lord
dialogueInline.text: Find out when their next holiday is. We're making this our new strategy.
